background_policy: Baseline2.25 and diagnostics2.4/2.5/2.6 use matching fit and GP-training masks; predictions/covariances recomputed, archived kernel coordinates unchanged; no separate guard.
sample_policy: Conditional supplied 2021 selected-candidate shapes; v13/v16 selection and signal daughter association not fully certified.
interpolation: requires explicit method and held-out checks before dense scan
claim_scope: conditional pointwise asymptotic CLs and local p0; descriptive paired scan agreement

finite_MC_precision.method: independent Poisson resampling of unit-weight histogram bins

morph.method: linear mixture of neighbouring CDFs in standardized residual z=(mrec-mpole)/sigma_nominal(mpole)
morph.data_training: MC histograms only; no observed-data shape fitting

selection_match: stored MC vertex type TargetConstrained and psum>2.8 cutflow; v13/v16 timing labels differ and full matching is unverified
signal_association: No truth-match selection; generated event pole does not establish candidate daughter identity.

histogram_support.overflow: Counted in metadata and all-selected support fractions; excluded from conditional-range quantiles.

candidate_flags: Both flags false in every row of bounded 100000-row-per-file diagnostic; no inferred ancestry result.
revision: MC-core-centered fit and training windows, 23 September 2026

core_window_centering.core_location: Local integrated Gaussian plus nonnegative affine pedestal
core_window_centering.Gaussian_control: centered at same MC core, same nominal width, same GP and conversion at pole
